scope_guards: The WC capacity is retained once at 150 net dwellings.
The permissioned status and No decision taken note are both preserved without silently resolving the conflict.
The temporary B8 and car-dealership permission is a separate non-residential use and not housing capacity.
The three-building Dairy Crest industrial scheme is not WC residential permission or additional dwellings.
Notification letters and responses are consultation metrics rather than dwellings.
The 2022 asset disposal context does not establish planning finality, implementation or exact title topology.
A point with blank geometry and a non-public ownership category do not identify an exact HMLR parcel.
No score or promotion is written without a reconciled current residential decision, exact title relation and executed overlays.
